department: Department of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences (Field of Geological Sciences)

deadline.value: The department lists January 1 for Fall; the catalog lists January 4. Apply by January 1.

also.quote: Fall, January 4; Spring, check with field.

gre_general.quote: Please note: GRE scores are not required.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages fetched.

english_waiver.value: Test waived after at least two years of English-taught study in a country where English is the official language.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL or IELTS exam is required of all international applicants from countries where English is not the official language unless the applicant has studied for at least two years in a country where English is the official language and the language of instruction was English.

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty before applying is strongly recommended.
supervisor.quote: We strongly recommend that potential applicants contact faculty members with whom they are interesting in studying before applying.

funding.value: Nearly all PhD students get tuition, academic-year stipend and health insurance for up to five years, mostly as research assistants on faculty grants.
funding.quote: Nearly all our Ph.D. and M.S. students receive financial aid that provides tuition, academic-year stipend and health insurance.

entry_route.value: Undergraduates from other fields are welcome; prior geology is not required.
entry_route.quote: applications from students with undergraduate degrees in other fields are welcome.

name: Geological Sciences
